governance_root_only.label: Governance root only
governance_root_only.change_record: Append CHANGELOG.md only when a real change occurs.

governance_observation.label: Read-only governance observation
governance_observation.change_record: Write only private observation evidence; do not mutate the target project.

project_root_execution.label: Enter project root and execute
project_root_execution.change_record: Append the project CHANGELOG.md only when a real change occurs.

required_before_every_start_or_switch: Resolve the registered project and explicit execution_scope.
At the governance root, check the root AGENTS.md and README.md and refresh the current queue/state when context changes.
For project_root_execution, enter the project root only after the governance preflight passes.
At the project root, check its nearest AGENTS.md and README.md and refresh its checklist/state before project commands.
Record the selected project, scope, reason, timestamps, and checked files in the private startup context report.
startup_switch_gate.stable_file_rule: Read and verify README.md and AGENTS.md every time; write them only when their content changes.
startup_switch_gate.unknown_scope_action: Block project commands and request explicit classification in the private registry.
startup_switch_gate.observation_exception: governance_observation may inspect a registered target and record missing or unknown controls without project commands, target mutation, or human approval.
